extras.real_size: four-engine turboprop cargo / transport airplane, high wing, approx. 29.7 x 38.4 x 12.1 m (L x wingspan x H), propeller diameter 4.0 m
extras.notes: nose faces -Y; stands on its landing gear (tandem main wheels in side pods, twin nose wheels); shown in loading pose: the rear ramp (cargo-plane_cargo_ramp, origin on its front hinge) is lowered onto the ground - rotate it by 28.4 deg around local X (glTF X) to close it flush with the fuselage; the upper rear cargo door (cargo-plane_cargo_door, origin on its rear hinge) is folded up into the tail - rotate by 40 deg around local X to close; the cargo hold has a simple interior with a pallet of crates; 4 propellers (origin on the hub, spin around the engine axis) and 6 wheels (origin on the axle, roll around local X) are separate objects; opaque tinted windows; no markings, no text, no registration

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
